headline: Trump calls Iranian plan to reopen Strait of Hormuz not 'acceptable'
context: President Trump said he was rejecting an Iranian plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. The Iranian proposal is similar to a memorandum of understanding agreed upon by the U.S. and Iran back in June.

sources.name: NPR
